title: Turrets
summary: Turrets shoot any predator in range while powered. Pick the right gun for the job.
text:
A **Defense Turret** shoots any hostile in range while it has power. Put them where packs come in, and beside anything out on its own.

Other guns cover what the turret can't:

- **Point Defense**: rapid fire at close range, shreds swarms and hits flyers
- **Siege Cannon**: long range, heavy shells that burst over an area, can't hit what's right under it, outranges spitters
- **Flak Tower**: only shoots flyers, but catches whole flocks
- **Sea Turret**: out on the water, out of reach of anything that walks

Guns are first in line for power, and draw little while idle. A Security officer working at a turret makes it hit harder. The research Fire Control and Hardened Plating make the whole line tougher.
